newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Telecom's Deane gets 25 pct salary hike in 96/97.
newsitem.headline: Telecom's Deane gets 25 pct salary hike in 96/97.

text.p: Telecom Corp of New Zealand chief executive Roderick Deane got a 25 percent hike in his salary and bonus package in 1996/97, the company's annual report published on Tuesday reveals.
The value of Deane's benefits came to just over NZ$1.5 million compared with $1.2 million a year earlier.
During the year Telecom's net profit fell to NZ$581.6 million from $716.8 million while operating profit fell to $980.5 million from $1.22 billion.
Chairman Peter Shirtcliffe received benefits of $105,000 and other directors received between $65,000 and $$70,000.
